planets.name: WASP-6 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Márohu with a 3.36-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: WASP-6 b was found in 2009 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Márohu. Its orbit and size follow McGruder et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MCGRUDER_ET_AL__2023): disc_year 2009, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.36100237, pl_radj 1.119, pl_bmassj 0.467

quotes.title: WASP-6b
quotes.card: WASP-6b, also named Boinayel, is an exoplanet approximately 650 light years away in the constellation Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered in 2008, by the WASP survey, by astronomical transit across its parent star WASP-6.
